name: Banh it la gai
summary: Bánh ít lá gai is a small cake in banana leaf, with a black skin of pounded ramie leaf and sticky rice around mung bean or coconut. Families make it for Tết, weddings, and ancestor offerings.
howToEat: ZaloPay: wrapped in green banana leaf, black skin from pounded ramie leaf mixed with sticky rice, filling of mung bean or coconut. Eaten at Tết and weddings, and offered to ancestors.
seoTitle: Banh it la gai in Quang Ngai
seoDescription: Bánh ít lá gai, a black ramie-leaf and sticky-rice cake in banana leaf, filled with mung bean or coconut for Tết and weddings.
